study_counts.warning: Counts are bookkeeping, not equal-cost fit/time estimates; widths, steps, preprocessing and baseline algorithms differ. All tuning, source qualification, pretraining/acquisition and failures extra.
study_counts.job_counting_assumption: One counted whole-model pipeline job per native/joint downstream configuration; each untied member one job. Native multistage optimizer phases, preprocessing, tuning and qualification are additional;120 is not a count of all internal optimizer instances.

parameter_formulas_per_HGT_layer.P_core: All native shared HGT trainable core parameters, source-specific.
parameter_formulas_per_HGT_layer.wider_control: Source-count smallest head-compatible global-BE width with total parameters>=CP; count gap reported.
parameter_formulas_per_HGT_layer.CP_vs_unrestricted_storage_condition: CP smaller iff M*R*d>M*d+M+R+d. Not asserted without bound R/sites.

private_execution: M complete recurrent member paths; at least member hidden-state and generally attention/message work. First-layer sharing may be source-specific, not assumed. No edge-channel computation or inference-speed saving claimed.
additional_costs: Native author recipe/code and VJP/operator equivalence qualification
SeHGNN feature and label propagation, sparse learned embeddings and any native acquisition
Recent foundation/adaptation pretraining/text encoders/alignment if a broader claim is pursued
Full training/inference/resource profiling including failed runs and contention
